mechanism: Tranylcypromine is a non-selective MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase and ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4/2D6 inhibitor; combined use creates risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and severe cardiovascular complications through monoamine accumulation and metabolism inhibition.
action: This combination is contraindicated; avoid concurrent use entirely and ensure adequate washout period (minimum 2 weeks after tranylcypromine discontinuation) before starting ritonavir.
